'''Corlis Brado Cressen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] as [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[First Organa Regiment]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the father of [[Andra Cressen]] and at least two sons.<ref name="The Servant Girl" />
